author: KEXP
description:
Hailing from Galicia, Spain, three-piece Triángulo de Amor Bizarro draw together post-punk, shoegaze, and noise rock to create their dark sonic world. Live on KEXP from Bilbao, the band share a high-energy performance of "Vigilantes del espejo" and more with host Albina Cabrera. 

Watch the full session and subscribe to keep up with more from our very first trip to Spain.
title: Triángulo de Amor Bizarro performs "Vigilantes del espejo" & more Live on KEXP
